justification: The witness refutes the same five-color guarantee. Its simple core is planar, obtained from K4 by inserting C4 and C5 into triangular faces; subdivisions, parallel paths, and leaves preserve planarity. Coloring C1–C4 with 1, C5 with 2, and all shared vertices/leaves with 3 makes the stated execution legal. The selection priorities hold, and n ultimately sees all five colors.
